They say his trail goes a little less than a kilometer and just disappears on stony ground where things get hilly.|Unidentified Stormtrooper on Ton Phanan's missing status|<ref name="IF" />}}
This '''stormtrooper''' was stationed on the planet [[Halmad/Legends|Halmad]] and served under [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]. He participated in the search for [[Wraith Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ton Phanan]] when his [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] crashed on the planet. This stormtrooper guarded the crash site and reported to two [[Raptors]] regarding the search. All three of them were subsequently shot to death by [[Garik Loran]], another Wraith who was also searching for his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]].<ref name="IF" />
